I liked the location of the property. It’s in a very quiet neighborhood. It was a short commute from downtown Savannah. It was plenty of room for my friends and I to be comfortable.
The lock on the door gave us some trouble throughout the stay. But the owner was a great help with this issue. I believe the master bedroom had bedbugs. I got confirmation this morning from my doctor that these were the bites of bedbugs on my arms and legs. I did reach out to the owner when I found out but no response as of yet.

Beyond the listing

What the neighbors report.

The site creator reports a shooting and damage to their vehicle, lawn, and home. The following photographs and correspondence were supplied with that account.

The insurance correspondence

The supplied March 3, 2026 letter records a reported September 14, 2025 shooting loss. It denies host liability, says police did not identify the shooters, and states that the host was not involved. This document is included as correspondence, not as a finding of wrongdoing by the host.
